verses.1: Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Praise the servants of Jehovah! Praise the name of Jehovah!
verses.2: May the name of the LORD be blessed from now on and forever.
verses.3: From east to west, the name of Jehovah is praised.
verses.4: Great is Jehovah over all the nations, and His glory fills the heavens.
verses.5: Who is like our God, who raises us from the dead?
verses.6: The one who sees in the heavens and on earth.
verses.7: I stand on the edge of a valley, far from the flames of war.
verses.8: To have friends who are generous and kind-hearted people.
verses.9: I will restore the house to its former glory. May the children be joyful and celebrate!
